Applying for jobs shouldn't take hours. Meet Hiresprint.
Start by uploading your resume. Hiresprint reads it and fills in your profile for you, so you only set up once.
On any job posting, Hiresprint shows how well each of your resumes matches the role, with the skills you have and the ones you're missing. You'll know right away which jobs are worth your time.
With one click, Hiresprint tailors your resume to the job. It rewrites your own bullet points in the job's language, never inventing experience, and your match score goes up before you even apply.

Now open the application and click Autofill. In seconds, every field is filled in: contact details, dropdowns, and screening questions, with your best-matching resume attached. Green answers come from your profile, and blue ones are AI suggestions to review. It even writes a cover letter for this exact job. What used to take twenty minutes now takes about one, and you always review and submit it yourself.
Run an ATS check to see how applicant tracking systems read your resume, and exactly what to fix.
In Answer Studio, save answers like salary, notice period, and relocation once, and they're filled the same way on every application.
Hiresprint works on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, LinkedIn, and more. Add it to Chrome for free, and apply in minutes, not hours.
